desc:
🌱 Welcome to Bahay Kubo Garden HALLOWEEN UPD!

Use code "BAHAYKUBO" and "HALLOWEEN" for ingame rewards!

Ready na ba kayong magtanim at magpalago ng sarili ninyong bakuran? Buy seeds from the shop, plant them, take care of your crops, and harvest them for profit! Discover rare fruits, collect pets, customize your farm, and build the garden of your dreams! 🌾

[How To Plant]
• Equip the seed you want to plant!
• Plant it on any available plot in your farm!
• Water your crops and wait for them to grow!
• Once they're fully grown, harvest them and sell your crops!

TIPS: 
Filipino? You can change your language in Settings!
Lagging? Turn off Graphics in Settings!

Your garden keeps growing even while you're offline! ⭐

🌱 Expect bugs! Happy farming, mga magsasaka!
